title: Recover profiler workers after timeouts
objective: Make persistent profiler workers recover cleanly after a bounded request timeout and prove it with a focused regression

handoff.summary: Persistent workers now await full process-group teardown before launching a replacement after a bounded timeout. A focused synthetic worker regression exercises immediate timeout recovery.
risks: The focused regression is platform-neutral, but native Windows execution remains for CI because this host is Linux.
next_steps: Register the focused test in the shared Node manifest from the integration lane.
